mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline during periods of low FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which may boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases when UNRATE decreases as specified.

mechanism_narrative: When both unemployment rate decreases and payroll employment increases, it indicates a robust labor market, which may lead to higher S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS does not correlate with positive SPX returns (correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts may indicate increased demand, but during a late-cycle expansion, this might not prevent a market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases despite rising HOUST in late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests strong economic activity, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher when INDPRO increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in retail sales may indicate overextension in consumer spending, leading to a correction in S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in >60% of cases when RSAFS increases as specified.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth slows but consumer price index rises, it may signal stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with negative SPX returns (correlation > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not higher when UNRATE is low (t-test p > 0.05).
